component.name: scan2paperless
component.summary: Scan documents and hand them to Paperless

description.p: A lean scanning app for SANE scanners: it scans from the feeder or the flatbed, turns the pages into a PDF and drops it straight into the Paperless-ngx consume folder. It reads the options the scanner offers and hides what it does not support. Driverless eSCL/AirScan (also over USB with ipp-usb) and vendor backends such as Brother brscan5 or Fujitsu work side by side. The interface is in German.
